entities.name: Access point name
entities.description: Information element included when UE wishes to request network connectivity as defined by a certain access point name.

entities.name: PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST
entities.description: Message that may contain the Access point name IE.

entities.name: ATTACH REQUEST
entities.description: Message that may contain the PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message.

entities.name: Emergency request type condition
entities.description: Condition when request type indicates emergency, handover of emergency bearer services, or RLOS.

ATTACH REQUEST message may contain PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message.
Access point name IE shall not be included when request type indicates emergency, handover of emergency bearer services, or RLOS.
